title: Marc Andreessen on Builder Culture in the Age of AI

reader_summary.headline: People are becoming what we now refer to as AI vampires.
reader_summary.overview: People are becoming what we now refer to as AI vampires. They've got these huge bags under their eyes. They're completely exhausted, but they're like you for it. We're entering the Golden Age, which is AI is going to be a superpower that everybody in the planet is going to have access to.

thesis: The discussion argues that AI is transitioning from a novelty to essential infrastructure, driving massive productivity gains while simultaneously reshaping work structures and information systems. It further explores the concept of 'suicidal empathy,' suggesting that certain social reform movements claim compassion while inflicting severe negative consequences on the very people they aim to help.
